description: Provenance of the vendored Fermix wire contracts. The canonical files live in the fermix repository under apps/fermix_core/priv/; this tree is a byte-identical copy pinned by CHECKSUMS.txt. scripts/verify_protocol_contract.sh asserts the two agree, and --source <fermix-checkout> byte-compares against upstream.

contracts.name: management
contracts.provenance_note: Taken from the fermix working tree at 8da1d054 on dev, where the Live voice engine is implemented and not yet committed, so committed_upstream is false and the release audience of verify_staged_app.sh refuses this pin until the engine publishes it. Protocol stays 2 on the 1 to 2 window: the engine field on the overview's realtime object, and the voice section's engine row with its engine-scoped model and voice options, the reasoning effort row that only the Realtime engine carries and the read-only backend row that only Live carries, are additive inside existing methods, so no method minimum moves.

contracts.name: realtime
contracts.provenance_note: Taken from the same uncommitted fermix working tree at 8da1d054 on dev, so committed_upstream is false and the release audience of verify_staged_app.sh refuses this pin until the engine publishes it. Protocol 2 adds the frames the Live engine needs: task_cancel from the pet, call_ready, caption and task from the daemon, the Live fields on usage, and kind, detail and required_for on error. The window is 1 to 2, so a pet speaking 1 still runs the Realtime engine against this daemon.
